fact: At end December 2023 five e-money issuers were licensed by the BRB, four operating, with 146.9 million transactions worth 6,125 billion BIF in 2023, but the BRB found no full interoperability between existing payment systems and launched a financial-sector digitalisation project to address it.
title: Rapport annuel sur les systèmes et moyens de paiement et leur surveillance, Exercice 2023
publisher: Banque de la République du Burundi
